Identities:
# Identities
## What the theme covers
Personal attributes, personal relationships, eating and drinking, and physical well-being.

## Useful language
Describe people with ser (es alto, es simpático) and states with estar (está cansado). Talk about family with tener: tengo dos hermanos. Say what you like with me gusta and me gustan.

## Key terms
la familia: family
el carácter: personality, what someone is like
la salud: health, how well your body is
la comida: food, or a meal such as lunch
me gusta: I like, used with one thing
Experiences:
# Experiences
## What the theme covers
Daily routine, leisure, holidays, festivals and celebrations.

## Useful language
Use reflexive verbs for routine: me levanto, me ducho. Talk about the past with the preterite: fui a la playa, comí paella. Use time markers: primero, después, luego, por la tarde.

## Key terms
la rutina diaria: daily routine
el ocio: leisure, free time
las vacaciones: holidays
la fiesta: festival, party
levantarse: to get up
Human ingenuity:
# Human ingenuity
## What the theme covers
Transport, entertainment, media and technology.

## Useful language
Compare with más que and menos que: el tren es más rápido que el autobús. Give opinions on technology: creo que el móvil es útil porque... Talk about frequency: siempre, a menudo, nunca.

## Key terms
el transporte: transport, ways of travelling
la tecnología: technology, digital tools and devices
el móvil: mobile phone, smartphone
las redes sociales: social media, apps for sharing online
útil: useful, helpful for a purpose
Social organization:
# Social organization
## What the theme covers
Neighbourhood, education, the workplace and social issues.

## Useful language
Describe places with hay and está: en mi barrio hay un parque; el colegio está cerca. Talk about school subjects and future plans with ir a + infinitive: voy a estudiar medicina.

## Key terms
el barrio: neighbourhood, the area where you live
el colegio: school, where children study
el trabajo: work, a job someone does
la asignatura: school subject such as maths
ir a + infinitivo: going to do something
Sharing the planet:
# Sharing the planet
## What the theme covers
Climate, physical geography, the environment and global issues.

## Useful language
Talk about weather with hace and hay: hace calor, hay niebla. Give advice with hay que and se debe: hay que reciclar; se debe ahorrar agua.

## Key terms
el medio ambiente: the environment, the natural world
el clima: climate, the usual weather of a place
reciclar: to recycle, to reuse materials
la contaminación: pollution, harmful waste in air or water
hay que: one must, it is necessary to
Paper 1: writing:
# Paper 1: writing
## The task
Paper 1 asks for short written texts in different text types, such as an email, a blog post, a diary entry or an informal letter. Choose the right register: informal for friends, formal for official readers.

## Doing it well
Answer every part of the task, organize ideas with connectors, use a range of tenses and check spelling and agreement.

## Key terms
el registro: register, formal or informal language
el tipo de texto: text type, such as an email or a blog
los conectores: linking words that organize ideas
el saludo: greeting at the start of a text
Paper 2: listening and reading:
# Paper 2: listening and reading
## The task
Paper 2 tests understanding of audio and written texts on the themes. Questions include multiple choice, true or false with justification, and short answers.

## Doing it well
Read the questions before listening, look for key words and synonyms, and copy exact words from the text when justifying.

## Key terms
verdadero: true, correct according to the text
falso: false, not correct according to the text
la justificación: justification, the words that prove the answer
el sinónimo: synonym, a word with the same meaning
Individual oral:
# Individual oral
## The task
The individual oral starts with a short presentation of a visual stimulus linked to a theme, followed by a conversation with the teacher.

## Doing it well
Describe the image, link it to the theme and to the target culture, give opinions with reasons, and keep the conversation going with questions.

## Key terms
la imagen: the image, the picture
en primer plano: in the foreground
al fondo: in the background
en mi opinión: in my opinion
